definitions.gloss: special order; custom order; made-to-order item
definitions.explanation: An item ordered with custom specifications, different from the standard product. Common in retail, fashion, and manufacturing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別注|べっちゅう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧です。
examples.english: This color is a special-order item.

examples.japanese: {別注|べっちゅう}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}→数量限定：09822_suuryougentei⟧です。
examples.english: The custom model is available in limited quantities.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧セレクト⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別注|べっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦コレクション→コレクション：07327_korekushon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: The limited collection that boutique commissioned from a famous brand is popular.

notes:
Commonly encountered in fashion and retail, where shops commission exclusive colorways or designs from brands. The compound uses ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate, special) + ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (order, abbreviation of ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧). Often used as a modifier: {別注|べっちゅう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (custom item).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別注|べっちゅう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: special-order item
- {別注|べっちゅう}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧: custom model
- {別注|べっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to place a special order (with a manufacturer)
- {別注|べっちゅう}⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧: exclusive colorway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特注|とくちゅう}→特注：13486_tokuchuu⟧: custom-made, bespoke (very close synonym; slightly more emphasis on unique specification)
- オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧: made-to-order (loanword, more for individual custom items)
- ⟦{受注|じゅちゅう}→受注：05133_juchuu⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: made-to-order production
